intro: Two pieces of pisang goreng have an estimated 200 kcal. Most of the calories come from the oil soaked up by the batter.
diet: Yes, as long as you watch how many. Two pieces are still okay as an occasional tea-time snack. Calories usually go up when you eat 4-5 pieces while lepak. Pick the crispy ones that aren't too oily.
tips: Buy just 2 pieces, not a big bag for the whole table.
Press with kitchen towel to remove extra oil.
Skip the cheese and condensed milk versions if you're in a deficit.

swap.name: 1 large fresh banana
swap.why: Same sweet taste without the oil, saving almost half the calories.

faq.q: Which banana is best for frying?
faq.a: Pisang raja, pisang nangka and pisang tanduk are most popular because they're sweet and don't go mushy when fried.

faq.q: How do I make pisang goreng crispy?
faq.a: Use a mix of rice flour and a little cornflour, and make sure the oil is really hot before frying.

faq.q: Can I make pisang goreng in an air fryer?
faq.a: Yes. Coat lightly with batter, spray a little oil and cook for about 10-12 minutes.
